hints.title: Prefix Range Counting
hints.text: Express the count of numbers in [l, r] as count(r) minus count(l - 1). Notice that any number with digit zero automatically has a product of zero, which is divisible by any positive digit sum.

hints.title: Digit State Tracking
hints.text: Construct numbers digit-by-digit from left to right, maintaining the digit index, tight upper bound constraint, leading zero flag, whether a zero was chosen, the sum of digits, and the product of non-zero digits.

hints.title: State Memoization
hints.text: Because digits are drawn from 1 to 9, non-zero digit products have prime factors limited to 2, 3, 5, and 7, resulting in very few distinct product states across up to 9 digits.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: S: number of distinct reachable (sum, prod) states
complexity.notes: Digit DP memoizes over the small set of reachable factorizations for single-digit products.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through every integer up to 10^9 exceeds the time limit.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Caching state transitions enables evaluation in sub-second time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use digit dynamic programming with state memoization to avoid brute-force iteration.
